context: Request: fund formations in the firm's files that carry a key-person provision (precedent for negotiating one). Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent fund, key-person in amended governing documents), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate Fund V), 1024-00002 (Driftwood, key-person amendment/event) and 1027-00002 (Pellegrino / Ridgeline-Clarion co-invest) qualify, plus a precision criterion; 1041-00005 (Solara master-fund reorganization), 1023-00001, 1026-00001 and 1002-00003 are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review says the few visible matters are not the whole store.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts files per matter folder for all folders; the stage-start note pointed to folder listing and the agent kept the store-listing label.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out twice; a range-argument rerun returns hits from part of the store only, with broad request terms. The review flags missing ranges and noise.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: tighter key-person regex over all ranges saved to files (about 170K characters, much of it engagement-letter boilerplate), then a request-word filter on the hits. The summary sets aside two key-person matters as non-formation matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: a stricter trigger-word regex fails on an inline-flag error; the fixed run times out twice with no output.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of five candidate matters picked from the scan; the review flags dozens of surfaced matters left unlisted.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Store-wide file-name regex for partnership-agreement, formation, co-invest and offering words; the summary calls amendment and restructuring hits non-formations.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: broader file-name regex printing per-matter counts (70 matters). The review names one restructuring matter with many hits as never examined.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of a structuring memo and agreement for each of five candidates. The review flags unopened surfaced matters and that no provision was confirmed.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Clause-extraction script over the agreements of the five candidates (about 137K characters). The review flags drafts treated as qualifying and the narrow candidate set.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four formation matters as qualifying, including a master-vehicle restructuring matter, and lists the amendment and restructuring matters as excluded near-misses. The review flags summary-only matters inflating the list.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, a path check fails on the workspace root then passes against the output folder, and edits one certificate description. The review asks to check the master-vehicle restructuring matter's formation scope without adding or dropping matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: reruns the clause script filtered to section headings and status lines; no edit.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It saw key-person text in two matters and set them aside as amendment and restructuring work rather than formations, and counted a master-vehicle restructuring matter as a formation.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The file-name search review at [59] named one of the two matters as in the output but never examined; the other was covered only by generic flags on unopened surfaced matters.
first_error.why: The answer excludes two matters with key-person provisions as post-formation amendment or restructuring work, a narrow reading of formation made from scan snippets and file names without opening them (evidence seen at [27]-[29] and [51]-[57]).

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The check review at [99] asked to check the master-vehicle restructuring matter's formation scope; the reopened check only reconfirmed draft status.
other_errors.why: The answer counts a master-vehicle restructuring matter's draft agreement as a formation with a key-person provision (evidence seen at [62]-[78]).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a two-level folder listing and file count.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Store-wide file-name regex for request document-type words in parallel with two content greps on bare *.docx and *.eml globs that return nothing. The review flags the cut-off output and the empty greps.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: word-bounded file-name regex saved to a file; 121 matters listed.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; two follow-ups fail on heredoc errors and one times out; range scans then print 1,323 hit files, filtered to a named list. The summary sets aside two key-person matters as a restructuring and an amendment.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: tight key-person scan in matter ranges; 125 matters with hits. The review flags a hand-picked subset of five.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads agreements, offering memoranda and a formation memo of four candidates chosen from the scan; the stage-start note pointed to screening and the agent kept its label. The review flags drafts only and the narrow set.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Clause-extraction script over the candidates (about 150K characters), one read of a co-invest agreement opening and a grep of the saved output.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two primary formation matters and a co-invest matter, plus a co-invest precedent and two side-letter negotiation precedents, and excludes the amendment and restructuring matters. The review flags the negotiation-precedent sections as widening the answer.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path check fails on the workspace root, then passes against the output folder; two edits expand citation lists. The review says to leave the matter set unchanged.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It saw key-person text in two matters and excluded them as an amendment and a restructuring, and added co-invest and side-letter matters as further precedents.

first_error.critic_note: No review named the two excluded matters or the reading of formation; the check review said to leave the matter set unchanged.
first_error.why: The answer excludes two matters whose key-person language its scan showed, treating them as post-formation amendment and restructuring work, without opening them (evidence seen at [32]-[34]).

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review said the negotiation-precedent sections may widen the answer with non-formation matters; the check stage only expanded citations.
other_errors.why: The answer presents a co-invest vehicle without a key-person clause and two side-letter negotiation matters as further key-person precedents (evidence seen at [45]-[63]).

stages.note: Attempt 3: store-wide byte count of key-person hits per matter, then a per-matter filter by agreement-type file names; the stage-start note pointed to screening and the agent read a new candidate under this label next.

runs.failure_point: It read the amendment and event documents of two key-person matters and excluded them as post-formation, and counted a master-vehicle restructuring matter as a formation.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [77] said the two matters were dismissed as post-formation; the agent kept the exclusion.
first_error.why: The answer excludes two matters whose key-person amendment and event documents it had read, as post-formation work rather than formations (evidence seen at [58]-[75]).

other_errors.critic_note: Reviews flagged drafts and unverified clause locations, not the master-vehicle restructuring matter's formation scope.
other_errors.why: The answer counts a master-vehicle restructuring matter's draft agreement as a formation with a key-person provision (evidence seen at [63] and [84]-[85]).

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the write stage: each saw key-person language in two matters (T0 and T1 only through scan snippets and file names, T2 after reading their amendment and event documents) and excluded them as post-formation work, while including a master-vehicle restructuring matter (T0, T2) or co-invest and side-letter matters (T1). Reviews named the exclusion specifically in T0 and T2, and the agent kept it; later check reviews told it to leave the matter set unchanged.
